title: NAYEON's Manila meet-and-greet moves to SM Aura as CHAGEE opens first PH flagship store
summary: NAYEON of global girl group TWICE is still set to meet her Filipino fans this November, but the venue for her much-anticipated Manila meet-and-greet has changed.
